description: Ask a human to approve an action; an approval returns a single-use Ed25519 approval pass

changes.description: Optional change preview: up to 20 { field, before, after } rows (text up to 200 characters, before or after may be null). The reviewer sees a before and after table; its SHA-256 is bound into the approval pass as chg, and the text is redacted before storage

summary.description: Up to 280 characters; redacted before storage

target.description: HTTPS webhook URL, or the reviewer key fingerprint (or "parent" for a sub-key)

name: hitl__escalate
